verdict.rationale: The docs say Transaction Aggregation data refreshes daily and can be refreshed on demand through the endpoints in a dedicated Data Refresh section. The Account Balance service also documents real-time versus cached balance retrieval, which together cover on-demand refresh through the API. missing for 10: detailed refresh semantics in the pack (sync vs async behavior, rate limits, completion signaling), the refresh endpoint specifics themselves, independent or hands-on corroboration.
